c1.summary: Implemented the Trickshot Cup round for real, as partial files on the existing CupRoundDriver skeleton plus four helpers (all new, nothing edited outside my ownership, CupRoundDriver.cs untouched). CupRoundDriver.Scene.cs builds the round under Setup.Root in Configure: the body plan per style (Solo/H2H human = shooter body + gloved keeper body twins with the same slot, only one Active per kick, the other parked hidden behind the goal; Co-op one body per order slot, keeper slot gloved; AI side = mirrored shooter bots + Goalkeeper), nation kits painted from CupNations.Design onto a full JerseyDesigns atlas (CupKitCache, freed on teardown), the referee (CupReferee: striped kit, black limbs, ball-ignored, WhistleRaise emote, ceremony walk helper), the free-kick spots (CupSpots: lazy seeded per-pair spots 17-28 m x +-18 m) and per-pair DefensiveWall rebuild, the replay recorder with the cup's own 3 s window, virtual body ids, the input gate (pause overlay / emote wheel / replay cut the local device, Space latched so no phantom release fires a kick), camera calls through CupCameraRig with GameCamera fallbacks, and every contract addition (Callout, Bodies, LocalBody, Referee, CaptainBody, Choreo/AttachChoreo, Rig, VoteSkipReplay, ReplayPlaying/SkipVotes/SkipNeeded, Taker, EmoteWheelOpen, SetCoinOutcome, BuildState, ClientSetReplay, ApplyBodyPose). CupRoundDriver.Kick.cs is the kick cycle exactly per design 7.2 with CupTuning timings: Intro (CupIntroCard) -> Placing (twin swap, ball/wall to the pair's spot, lineups, referee mark, KeeperAbility per stage, AI taker walk-in via Choreo) -> WhistleRaise (0.4 s, PlayWhistle at the end) -> Armed (SetPieceTaker with GameInput/NetInputSource/CupBotTaker, LookAimPoint for humans, corner auto-aim + TakerCombined for AI, 12 s kick clock -> weak seeded AutoLaunch(0.6)) -> Live (KickSpeed/RestSpeed/RestHold/MaxLiveTime, SaveWatch, wall touch = SAVED, goal test) -> Verdict (ResolveKick, callout + crowd, 1.3 s hold, replay ring frozen) -> Scored (scorer freed + scorer-only skip) or WalkBack (Choreo hook, <= 3.5 s) -> replay (goal/save only, unanimous latched vote) -> Placing, or Decided (win beat 5 s with the winning humans freed, dejection 4 s, referee raise + PlayWhistleTriple, scorer/winning-keeper skip) -> replay -> Over. Local authority is complete; Host = the same sim + FeedRemoteInputs with TODO(net) for publishing; Client mirrors CupRoundState (roles, twin visibility, cameras, windows, kick callouts) and poses puppets through ApplyBodyPose. CupBotTaker drives the real charge/run-up/strike through IStrikerInput from a seeded stream (0.8-1.6 s delay, release at the stage's power target, seeded spin/foot). Statics and the ball's SetPieceShot are restored, materials/textures freed, wall cleared in OnDestroy.

f.notesForNextAgents:
FLOW AGENT (E): the coin toss is self-contained. Sequence per round: StartRound -> (Rig assigned, Choreo attached) -> wait Driver.SceneBuilt under the loading card -> director.SetPhase(CupPhase.CoinToss) BEFORE CupCoinToss.Begin (director.CallCoin DROPS calls outside that phase - the ceremony still runs on the local pick and logs one warning, but predictions and tallies are lost) -> CupCoinToss.Begin(director, driver, rig, onDone: () => driver.Begin()). CupCoinToss itself calls driver.SetCoinOutcome, driver.SetFirstKicker and (authority only, guarded by 'no call has a verdict yet') director.ResolveCoinCalls - do NOT call ResolveCoinCalls again or CoinCallsMade double-counts; read toss.Result / OfficialCall / FirstKicker if you need them. CupCareer.CoinCalled for the local call stays yours (per B1's notes). Call director.ClearCoinCalls() before the NEXT round's toss (the ceremony reads CupPlayer.CoinCall as this toss's call). The referee and captains are left where the ceremony stopped them; the driver's Intro entry (ParkAllAtMarks) puts everyone back, so Begin() right after onDone is safe. Cancel() aborts (no onDone) for a leaver / End Match.

NET AGENT: choreography and body movement run ONLY on Local/Host; a client sees them through the snapshot (emoteId/phase per body incl. the referee's VirtualSlot, positions/yaw). For a REMOTE official caller the client's ceremony waits on director.PlayerAt(slot).CoinCall - replicate CupPlayer.CoinCall in CupState promptly, else the client's 6.5 s timeout picks HEADS locally; the seeded result face is identical everywhere, and the host's CupRoundState (CoinCall/CoinResult/FirstKicker) rewrites the client's line on ApplyState, so a late call can only mismatch the CLIENT's intro card, never the rules.

PODIUM AGENT: CupPoses.LoserPose(variant) are 13-entry arrays for ActiveRagdoll.DisplayPose (or Apply on a live body); roll the variant from CupSalts.Podium. CupPoses.WinEmotes are standing cheers that leave the left forearm alone except MuscleFlex/Clap - curate your own wheel page.

CONVENTION WARNING (owner of Celebration.cs / RagdollPose consumers): the tree disagrees with itself on the lateral pose sign. Derivation in the CupPoses header: rest local rotation is identity (ActiveRagdoll.Build), JointMath drives the joints to the target skeleton faithfully, Unity's +Z rotation takes -Y toward +X, so +Z swings a hanging limb toward the character's RIGHT - KeeperPose's header, which records the on-screen bug that proved it. EmotePose's header claims the opposite and its symmetric wheel poses (TPose L+90/R-90, Cheer, HandsUp, KneeSlide...) are authored to it - they most likely cross the arms in front of the chest (which is exactly 'the user's issue' ClampArms was written for, and ClampArms' own FK can never fire because its abduction step lowers clearance and breaks). I re-solved only the five cup emotes I own. If a play-mode look proves EmotePose right after all, flip the Z signs in CupPoses (one block of constants) and revert my three Celebration hunks.

DRIVER SEAMS: the only Kick.cs edit is the OwnsBody guard in TickKeeperOnLine. CupChoreo.Walk sets body.Freed=false on the body it walks (the AI scorer, the walk-back shooter): the driver's Hold is then a no-op for it, harmless. Lineup bodies keep LocomotionEnabled = true with zero MoveInput (the velocity steer holds them on the mark for a whole round; sway is rotational and unaffected) - the design's 'locomotion off' would let a neighbour's arm nudge them off the line. Heads in the lineup follow the LIVE ball within +-45 yaw / +-20 pitch.

FREE KICKS (C1 / design): CupSpots.LineupZ puts both lineups 17.5 m from goal facing +Z; a free-kick spot 17-28 m out is BEHIND them and the 4-man wall (9.15 m from the ball on the ball->goal line) can land on the +6 lineup for spots around (8, -26.6). The lineup heads clamp at +-45 so they cannot even look back at the ball. Consider a per-format lineup mark (behind the ball, on the touchline side).

TUNING LEVERS: CupChoreo constants (walk-in speed multiplier / budget, scorer run, emote gap, fall push, head cones), CupCoinToss constants (ceremony spot 2 m short of the penalty spot - the dead ball sits ON the spot in Penalties; captain jog speed; timeouts; bounce), CupPoses.DrapeOut/Back/Down. The referee's toss-arm pose is hand-authored (not FK-solved); the coin launches from the REAL forearm transform so the arc is right whatever the pose.
openIssues: Not run in the Unity editor (no MCP this session per the brief): the drape pose's physical settle between live neighbours, the DejectFall topple (torso+head VelocityChange 2.0/2.6 m/s backward with balance/upright off), the lineup sway/breath, the coin's read at 5 m, the overlay layout and the calls band are compile- and FK-verified only. First play-mode pass: watch a Co-op lineup of 3+ and one DejectFall on the losing keeper.

The lateral pose convention in EmotePose's header contradicts KeeperPose + the maths; I followed KeeperPose (see notes). If a play-mode look shows my lineup/loser poses mirrored, flip the Z signs in CupPoses and revert the three Celebration hunks - and the older wheel emotes (TPose etc.) are then correct; if mine are right, the wheel emotes cross their arms and are somebody else's fix.

director.CallCoin drops calls unless director.Phase == CupPhase.CoinToss; the flow must set that phase before CupCoinToss.Begin or predictions/tallies are lost (the ceremony still completes on the local pick and warns once).

ResolveCoinCalls is not idempotent (it bumps CoinCallsMade); CupCoinToss runs it on the authority guarded by 'no call has a verdict yet' - the flow must not call it a second time for the same toss, and must ClearCoinCalls before the next round's toss.

A client's ceremony resolves a REMOTE official caller from CupPlayer.CoinCall (needs the net agent's CupState echo); with no echo it picks HEADS locally after 6.5 s. The seeded result face is identical on every peer and the host's CupRoundState rewrites FirstKicker on ApplyState, so only the client's intro card could briefly disagree.

Free-kick lineups stand at the box edge facing the goal, so the ball (17-28 m) is behind them and the wall can overlap the +6 line for some spots; a per-format lineup mark is needed (C1/design), not fixable from the choreography.

The walk-back from the penalty spot to a lineup mark is ~6.9 m = 4.3 s at CupTuning.WalkSpeed 1.6, longer than WalkBackMax 3.5 s, so the driver's cut always hides a snap; raise WalkSpeed or shorten the marks if the arrival should be seen.

Solo shows only the human captain at the toss (design 7.1 says so) while a Head to Head vs-AI round shows the AI captain too - a deliberate reading of the text; one constant-free branch in CupCoinToss.Setup if the owner wants Solo to match.

AI keeper bodies dropped by DejectFall on the line stay down until the round root is destroyed; if a replay follows the decisive kick the ReplaySystem puppets and restores them, which was desk-checked only.

public void MenuBackdrop()                        // Rig.CoinTossView(ground(PenaltySpot), Vector3.back): a static wide shot toward the goal for the scrimmed screens
public static bool PodiumAvailable { get; }       // Type.GetType("Trickshot.CupPodium") has a public static Begin (probed once)
public bool TryBeginPodium()                      // invokes CupPodium.Begin with args filled BY TYPE: CupDirector=this, Transform=a fresh "PodiumRoot" under the director, CupCameraRig=Rig, CupHud=Hud, GameInput, Camera, GameCamera, BallController, Action=ContinueFromResults; a returned Component is tracked; false when absent or it threw
